stem: Based on paragraphs 5 and 6 of the selection “Why I Write Longhand,” what can be inferred about the author’s feelings?
instruction: Use “Why I Write Longhand” to answer the following question.

options.label: A
options.text: He is excited about trying new writing techniques.

options.label: B
options.text: He is upset that he has wasted so much time.

options.label: C
options.text: He is relieved that others agree with his beliefs.

options.label: D
options.text: He is confused about which methods to use in planning his writing.
